contracts.protected_operation: HTTP request handling for the DevUI API — in particular POST /v1/responses (local agent-entity execution via executor.execute_sync/execute_streaming and the OpenAI proxy branch), the deployment endpoints, and the conversation endpoints.
contracts.protected_resource: The DevUI HTTP API surface, including registered agent/workflow entities reachable via /v1/responses and Azure deployment operations.
contracts.protection_obligation: When DEVUI_AUTH_TOKEN is configured, the DevUI server's HTTP authentication middleware must reject requests to all non-exempt API paths (including /v1/responses entity execution and OpenAI proxy, /v1/deployments, and /v1/conversations) that lack a Bearer token constant-time matching the configured token, before any endpoint handler executes; additionally, serve() must refuse to start network-exposed/production-like deployments (auth_enabled=True) without an explicit DEVUI_AUTH_TOKEN.
scope_limits: This is a generic Bearer-authentication middleware over the whole API; it is included only because the guarded endpoints concretely execute registered agent entities (POST /v1/responses handler calls executor.execute_sync/execute_streaming). The middleware itself is not registered as an agent tool, agent lifecycle hook, or fed by agent-generated input.
Exemptions by design: OPTIONS preflight, /health, /meta, /, and /assets bypass authentication.
The middleware is only registered when DEVUI_AUTH_TOKEN is set (auth_required); without a token, network exposure without authentication is only warned about in serve() (advisory logging).
